value.text: What a beautiful sight! By the by, did you remember to bring a grappling hook? There's still time to turn back and get one if you forgot.
These must be the cultists we were warned about. I'm sure there're more of them in the forest.
Did the cultists set this trap?
The forest is sending forth its own guardians to fight the cultists. I don't think they recognise that you're trying to help them, though.
Keep on your toes. I'm detecting a massive energy signature ahead.
The path forks here. I'm detecting lifesigns on both ends, so take your pick.
A frog village. How quaint. The locals don't look friendly.
This hatch seems to lead into some ruins. Maybe you should check around town to see if the locals have rigged some controls up.
The door's locked, and the switch is on the inside of the bell tower. Is there a way to trigger, or failing that, destroy it?
Cultists! Just what are they doing here?
This frog looks pretty lonely, I think he'd like your company.
Well, that was quite the sticky situation. Are you all right?
This is an interesting one. Do you have a rocket launcher that can do guided rockets? I don't think you'll be able to reach the switch otherwise.
There's no way around it - the console holding the door shut is also connected to the hatch in front of you. I'm sorry, but to proceed you'll need to incinerate the dog.
Oh look, it's this again. To get at all those sweet, sweet pixels you'll need to consign this cat to a slow, painful, needless death.
Do you smell an ambush? Because all that darkness sure does.
Oh, I just figured out what else the cat console was linked to - the door you just came through. Good thing you weren't greedy and avoided being bitten in the ass by karma, eh?
